## Current edit prompt

Use case: style-transfer.
Asset: square Stardeus Steam Workshop mod cover.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the current finished cover.

Revise the clothing illustration to be unmistakably CARTOONISH and approachable, like stylized sci-fi colony-sim inventory art. Replace the realistic, grimy fabric rendering with chunky simplified silhouettes, clear dark outlines, flat color areas and soft cel shading. Draw a slightly battered purple/grey space-colonist utility jacket, a tan shirt, folded trousers and chunky boots in roughly the current arrangement. Convey wear with a few simple zigzag hems, small clean-edged holes, visible repair patches and a handful of muted brown dirt smudges. Make the clothes look comically overdue for the laundry rather than horrific. No bodies, body parts, bones, wounds, skulls, flies, menacing additions, or distressed characters. Do not turn the jacket or shirt into a humanoid or a person. Preserve the large red circle with a diagonal slash over the clothes, its position and meaning. It can be slightly smoother and cleaner, but retain the clear bold warning symbol.
Keep the dark sci-fi locker-room setting, glowing purple angular border, purple circuit decoration, small star ornament, existing square composition, and bottom-right compatibility badge. Preserve ALL existing lettering, spelling, placement, legibility and size: title exactly "TRAITS AND" / "CLOTHING" / "COMPATIBILITY", and badge "STARDEUS" / "v0.15" / "COMPATIBLE". Do not introduce any new text, logos, slogans or version numbers. Preserve the professional series-cover styling of the title and border; the primary change is a substantially simplified, friendly cartoon rendering of the clothing. Match the original dimensions and full frame without cropping.

## Original generation prompt (superseded illustration)

Create a finished square Steam Workshop mod cover, high-resolution, for the Stardeus mod titled exactly "Traits and Clothing Compatibility". This is a new standalone cover in a cohesive established series: near-black/navy sci-fi spacecraft background, luminous violet angular double-line technological border inset around all four edges, subtle purple circuit traces, polished detailed 3D game-poster illustration, very large beveled pale-lavender block typography with restrained purple glow. High contrast and immediately readable as a small square thumbnail.

COMPOSITION: Upper 58%: a small clearly readable group of discarded space-colonist clothing, prominently a worn grey/olive utility jacket or uniform with torn hems, obvious holes and frayed fabric, dirty boots or folded trousers nearby, and a bloodstained shirt. Dirt and dried dark-red blood stains are visible on the fabric, but NO person, body, wounds or gore. Place this clothing against a dark spaceship locker-room floor or subtle bulkhead so the silhouettes are clear. One large bright red prohibition symbol (a red circular ring with a single diagonal slash from upper left to lower right) overlays the group of clothes, conveying that these garments are forbidden. Make the clothing large, textured and recognizable beneath the symbol; avoid a slash so thick it hides the clothing. This clothing plus red prohibition symbol is the main visual focus, not a character.

Lower 38%: Exact title text, all caps permitted, in three centered readable lines: "TRAITS AND" / "CLOTHING" / "COMPATIBILITY". All letters correctly spelled, no abbreviation, no extra subtitle or slogan. Broad condensed geometric sci-fi block lettering, dimensional bevel, pale lavender-white faces and purple edges matching the border. Fit the long word COMPATIBILITY fully inside safe margins without clipping. Leave enough dark breathing space behind text.

In the very bottom right, a modest small angular violet outlined compatibility badge with these exact three lines: "STARDEUS" / "v0.15" / "COMPATIBLE". Keep badge below or clear of the title, never overlapping letters. A small understated purple four-point star ornament may be centered at the bottom edge, matching the series. No watermark or logos other than the specified title/badge. Do not add the mod version 1.0.0 to the art. No other text. Professional polished finished cover, square format, balanced negative space, sharp legibility, controlled purple and red lighting.
